name: Killik
description: The Killik were an insectoid sentient species known to reside in nests. Around 4 ABY, the New Republic Vanguard Squadron pilots Keo Venzee and Feresk Tssat led a mission to recover an astromech droid from Laanen, an ice moon of the gas giant Navlaas. In response, the Imperial Logistics Division confiscated all supplies of Clouzon-36 from the nearby space stations of the Navlaas Triad, an action that the New Republic intelligence chief Ardo Barodai likened to the buzzing of a Killik nest. During the First Order-Resistance War, Poe Dameron and Finn encountered a Killik and their nest in a passenger car of a train on a mission on the planet Kamil to negotiate a deal for livestock that the Resistance needed.

data.name: Killik
